subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
TB Solution: 

The correct answer is built up.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Built-up means** to accumulate or develop appreciably. **(निर्मित भवनों से आच्‍छादित)

 -Example: It seemed that years of **built-up** anger and frustration had erupted. 

 
• "Built-up" is the adjective.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **"building"** means a structure, such as a house, shop or school, that has a roof and walls.
 
• **"build in"** means incorporating something and making it a permanent part of a structure, system, or situation.
 
• **"build on"** means using something as a basis for further development.

Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'built up'
